scope: Separate Free Update 20 skill provenance from Dragon Ball DAIMA Pack paid-DLC provenance.

official_evidence.finding: Bandai Namco's Japanese announcement separately lists the six DAIMA Pack skills and four Budokai Festival skills under Free Update 20.
Bandai Namco America explicitly states that the DAIMA Pack contains player skills and that the accompanying free update separately contains Skills.
Bandai Namco Europe likewise separates the paid DAIMA Pack from the accompanying free update containing Skills.

reconciliation.paid_event: Dragon Ball DAIMA Pack / May 22 2025 (regional release announcements differ by one day)

canonical_action: No canonical skills.json mutation for the four Festival identities because exact internal IDs remain unresolved. Existing six DAIMA Pack canonical mappings remain unchanged.
